duas.title: When in the State of Iḥrām
duas.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ حَجَّةٌ لَا رِيَاءَ فِيْهَا ، ‏‏‏‏‏‏وَلَا سُمْعَةَ
duas.transliteration: Allāhumma ḥajjatun la riyā'a fiha, wa lā sum'ata.
duas.translation: O Allah, a ḥajj in which there is no showing off nor reputation sought.
duas.virtue: Anas b. Mālik (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) narrated: “The Prophet ﷺ performed ḥajj on an old saddle, wearing a cloak that was worth four dirhams or less. Then he said \[the above\]. (Ibn Mājah)

duas.title: Talbiyah in Hajj & ʿUmrah
duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ ، لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayk Allāhumma labbayk, labbayka lā sharīka laka labbayk, inna-l-ḥamda, wa-n-niʿmata, laka wa-l-mulk, lā sharīka lak.
duas.translation: I am here at Your service, O Allah; I am here at Your service, I am here at Your service; You have no partner whatsoever; I am here at Your service. Truly all praise, favour and sovereignty is Yours; You have no partner whatsoever.
duas.virtue: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar (radiy Allāhū ‘anhumā) narrates that the talbiyah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was \[the above\]. (Bukhārī 1549) The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Jibrīl came to me and commanded me to order my Companions (radiy Allāhū ‘anhum) to raise their voices in uttering the talbiyah.” (Abū Dāwūd)

duas.title: When Reaching al-Ḥajar al-Aswad (The Black Stone)
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest.

duas.title: Between al-Rukn al-Yamani (Yemeni Corner) & al-Hajar al-Aswad (Black Stone)
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَآ اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fi-d-dunyā ḥasanah wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā ʿadhāba-n-Nār.
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.
duas.virtue: ʿAbdullāh b. as-Sā’ib (radiy Allāhū ʿanhu) narrated: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say \[the above\] between the two corners (al-Rukn al-Yamānī and al-Ḥajar al-Aswad).” (Abū Dāwūd 1892)

duas.title: At Maqām Ibrāhīm
duas.translation: Take the standing-place of Ibrāhīm as a site of prayer. (2:125)
duas.virtue: Jābir (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) said: “…Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to the Maqām (standing-place) of Ibrāhīm and said \[the above\]. He prayed two rakʿahs, placing the Maqām between him and the Kaʿbah…(In the first rakʿah) he recited Sūrah al-Ikhlāṣ (and in the second rak’ah), he recited Sūrah al-Kāfirūn.” (Muslim)

duas.title: When Approaching Ṣafā to begin Saʿy
duas.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَآئِرِ اللّٰهِ ، أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللّٰهُ بِهِ ،
duas.transliteration: Inna-ṣ-Ṣafā wa-l-Marwata min shaʿāiri-llah, abda'u bi-mā bad'allāhu bihi.
duas.translation: Indeed, Ṣafa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah (2:158). I begin with what Allah began with.
duas.virtue: Jābir (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) said: “Then, when he ﷺ approached Ṣafā, he \[said the above\].” (Muslim)

duas.title: Each Time on Safa & Marwah
duas.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ ، اَللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā-llāh, Allāhu Akbar, lā ilāha illā-llāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, lahu-l-mulku wa lahu-l-ḥamdu yuḥyī wa yumīt, wa Huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in Qadīr, lā ilāha illā-llāh, anjaza waʿdah, wa naṣara ʿabdah, wa hazama-l-aḥzāba waḥdah.
duas.translation: There is no god worthy of worship except Allah. Allah is the Greatest. He is Alone and He has no partner whatsoever. To Him Alone belong all sovereignty and all praise. He is over all things All-Powerful. There is no god worthy of worship except Allah. He fulfilled His promise, granted victory to His servant, and He Alone defeated the coalition forces.
duas.virtue: Jābir (raḍiy Allāhu ʿanhu) said: “The Messenger of Allah began with Ṣafā and climbed it until he could see the Kaʿbah. He then faced the qiblah, proclaimed the Oneness of Allah and glorified Him, and then said لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ. He then made duʿā’ in between (the takbīr and the dhikr), and repeated this three times… He then made duʿā’ between three recitals of (the above)… He then did on Marwah what he did on Ṣafā.” (Muslim 1218) Note: The above Dhikr should be recited x3. Duʿā’ should be made after each recital.

duas.title: Between Ṣafā & Marwah
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْأَعَزُّ الْأَكْرَمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir wa-rḥam innaka Anta-l-Aʿazzul Akram. ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd and ʿAbdullah b. ʿUmar (radiy Allāhū ʿanhum) would both say \[the above\] during saʿy. (Ṭabarānī in al-Duʿā’ 870)
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy. Truly You are the Most Mighty, the Most Noble.

duas.title: On the Day of ʿArafah
duas.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
duas.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā-Allāh, waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, lahu-l-mulk, wa lahu-l-ḥamd, wa Huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in Qadīr.
duas.translation: There is no god worthy of worship but Allah. He is Alone and He has no partner whatsoever. To Him Alone belong all sovereignty and all praise. He is over all things All-Powerful.
duas.virtue: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “The best duʿā’ is the duʿā’ of the day of ʿArafah. The best of what I and the Prophets before me have said is \[the above\].” (Tirmidhī 3585)

duas.title: On Every Throw at the Jamarāt
